parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ records: [{ deployment_ref: $json.deployment_ref, external_id: 'n8n:' + $json.execution_id, source: 'n8n', started_at: $json.started_at || $now.toISO(), finished_at: $json.finished_at || $now.toISO(), status: ['success','failed','needs_human'].includes($json.status) ? $json.status : 'success', token_cost: $json.token_cost === undefined || $json.token_cost === '' ? null : Number($json.token_cost), model: $json.model || null }] }) }}

nodes.name: POST run to ledger
nodes.notes: Credential: Header Auth with Name = x-ingest-key and Value = your ingest key (Settings → Ingest keys). Replace YOUR-LEDGER-DOMAIN. Errors don't fail the calling workflow.

meta.description: Call this from the end of any workflow with Execute Workflow. Pass execution_id = {{ $execution.id }} from the CALLING workflow (inside this sub-workflow $execution.id is the sub-workflow's own id). external_id becomes n8n:<execution id>, which is the same key the n8n connector and Langfuse matching use, so re-sends update instead of duplicating.
